title: PAY-002 Commerce Order API Candidate Admission Gate
purpose: Tracks admission and implementation evidence for the Commerce Order create/read API; contract admission does not enable public runtime routes.

requiredEvidence.requirement: Canonical OpenAPI contains both operations with closed DTO schemas, common error envelopes and an explicit request-body budget.

order.create and order.read are admitted to the canonical permission catalog with own scope, L2 minimum layer, and explicit verified_user/admin/super_admin grants; runtime owner-isolation tests remain separately required.
W07 resolves every submitted itemRef to an authoritative purchasable item/offer, immutable version and current price; unsupported/unavailable items fail closed.

evidence.scopeLimit: Admits W07 current public membership-plan item/version/current-price resolution and its PostgreSQL 18 evidence. Does not admit production discount/tax authority, seller-of-record, real-money checkout, or production order writes.

requiredEvidence.requirement: The closed create/read response DTO properties map to canonical ENT-ORDER and ENT-ORDER-LINE fields or explicit transport/relation sources; customerId, internal persistence columns, raw snapshot JSON, provider data, ledger rows and entitlement snapshots are excluded.

The canonical D1-04 UUID and Wrangler display name matched current read-only Cloudflare inventory; a source-commit schema snapshot was collected. This is identity/schema discovery evidence only and does not authorize any migration or runtime write.
A separately reviewed D1-04 migration candidate and exact post-migration schema/constraint evidence must pass before runtime writes are enabled.

evidence.scopeLimit: Admits the already-applied W07 D1-04 schema and its exact historical remote PostgreSQL 18 catalog/constraint readback, now reconciled to 27/27 current-main source pins and a fresh local PostgreSQL 18 source-equivalent validation. Does not authorize new remote DDL, business-data import, Cloudflare D1 writes, production cutover or production charging. The canonical shared runner remains local-only/remote-apply-blocked; the separately reviewed schema-only workflow still requires explicit manual dispatch and exact confirmation.

requiredEvidence.requirement: Same key and same semantic request replays the original response; same key with a different request hash is rejected atomically with order creation.

evidence.scopeLimit: Admits atomic idempotency/replay/conflict/concurrency and rollback evidence on disposable PostgreSQL 18. It does not activate production order creation or payment.

requiredEvidence.requirement: Route enforces bounded request-body size, item-count/quantity limits and existing W01/W07 anti-abuse controls before any D1 write.

configuredLimits.w01AccountAndOperationBuckets: Existing W01_WRITE_LIMITER namespace, keyed separately by authenticated account and fixed operation
configuredLimits.activeMembershipResolverAdditionalLimits: Exactly one membership plan line and quantity 1

assertions: W01 edge/origin limit executes before identity resolution
W01 account and fixed-operation limits execute before W08 authorization and W07 forwarding
Each exhausted W01 bucket returns 429 and short-circuits downstream calls
W01 and W07 enforce 16 KiB streamed request-body bounds
W07 DTO validator rejects item counts above 50 and quantities above 10000
W07 applies origin/global and principal write rate limits before the order handler
51 order lines are rejected before resolving Neon stores or pricing
quantity 10001 is rejected before resolving Neon stores or pricing

evidence.scopeLimit: Admits route-level anti-abuse controls only. No rate-limit namespace or infrastructure was added; no D1/Neon writes, real payment, or production deployment was performed.

requiredEvidence.requirement: Exact-commit tests cover create/read, malformed/unknown fields, price spoofing, missing key, replay/key-reuse conflict, owner isolation, unavailable items, concurrency and recovery.
Schema, migration, security and runtime evidence is admitted against the exact implementation commit; PAY-002 stays unresolved until downstream mapping checks pass.

greenRule: This gate cannot be GREEN while any implementation evidence is PENDING; canonical contract admission is distinct from runtime/production admission, and PAY-002 remains unresolved.
nextAction: Complete E2E-SECURITY-01 as one exact-main create/read security matrix covering request validation, price spoofing, unavailable/private items, owner isolation, idempotent replay and conflict, concurrent submission, rollback/recovery, W06 audit durability and W08 authorization. Then record EVIDENCE-REGISTRY-01 from the exact passing commit. Keep live order writes fail-closed while production discount/tax authority and seller-of-record remain unresolved.
